notes.title: Immersion Update: Visual Feedback, Turrets, and Environmental Enhancements
notes.content:
Here’s what’s new in this update:

Camera Shake: Added subtle camera shake effects when shooting over the shoulder and when taking damage, to enhance immersion.

Blood Screen: A blood screen effect has been added when the player is hit, providing better visual feedback.

Damage Indicator: You’ll now see the direction from which damage is coming, making combat awareness more intuitive.

23mm Cannon Turrets: New 23mm turrets have been placed to defend key areas in the village. These are fully destructible.

Snow Effects: Snow now covers all surfaces, including vehicles, enemies, and the player, for improved environmental realism.

Tracer Rounds: Enemy gunfire now includes tracer rounds, increasing visibility and intensity during combat encounters.

Watch out, dying enemy now randomly detonate hand grenades as they die, adding another edge to the close-quarters combat.

Save/Load System: Work is ongoing on the save/load system. It’s not ready yet but will be included in a future update.

Thanks for playing and providing feedback.

notes.title: Vehicle Collision Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=3tIl7LfbX6E;full][/previewyoutube]

I've made an update fix to address some of your feedback regarding the three drivable vehicles:

- Vehicles are no longer stopped dead when colliding with an enemy soldier
- Vehicles are now easier to access with the vehicle entry point made larger - it's now faster and more intuitive to acceess a vehicle in the heat of the battle.

Stay tuned for further updates, I've got some exciting ones coming up!

notes.title: Dev Update: Dynamic Weather, Time, and Night Vision!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I’ve been hard at work refining the game, and I'm excited to share some game-changing updates with you.

- [b]Dynamic Weather[/b]: You may have noticed in my latest screenshots—blizzards, thick fog, and raging thunderstorms now roll in randomly, keeping every playthrough intense and unpredictable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193350/e18c28862cc8f6c73fa3be5cea3682e25e5642b5.jpg[/img]

- [b]Day/Night Cycle[/b]: Darkness brings high-stakes stealth—prowl through the shadows, evade enemy floodlights, and strike from the cover of night. But beware! Total darkness can be just as dangerous, leaving you disoriented and vulnerable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193350/548d4d58e413d91d46e9bb893b4f5c8e3ebb7d72.jpg[/img]

- [b]Night Vision[/b]: To counter the darkness, I’ve added temporary, rechargable night vision! Scan the battlefield, spot hidden threats, and take out enemies before they even know you’re there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193350/039f17f8569cc6ba0d95f5ed842eccc200e08117.jpg[/img]

I can’t wait for you to experience these awesome new features! Stay tuned—[b]our Early Access release is just around the corner![/b]

notes.title: Exciting Update: A New Chapter in Our Journey!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193350/f3a4c096c0d5829e7f995f3712b339df215eea6c.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone,

I’ve been hard at work behind the scenes, and now I'm thrilled to share some incredible progress with you! Your support, wishlists and patience have been instrumental in getting me this far, and I'm confident you’ll love what’s coming next.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193350/ac208a2f258383940063a97a27a7af80fe09f731.jpg[/img]

Here’s what I’ve been up to:

• [b]A Vastly Expanded World[/b]
The level environment has been completely overhauled. It’s not just bigger—it’s better. Realistic, immersive, and alive with details, this world is designed to pull you in and keep you exploring.

• [b]Enhanced Immersion[/b]
I’ve dialed up the realism with a focus on sound design and ambiance. Every audio cue and atmospheric sound is crafted to make you feel like you’re truly alone, fighting against all odds.

• [b]Vehicles & Mechanics[/b]
Get ready for a new layer of gameplay with vehicles and mechanics that bring fresh challenges and opportunities to the battlefield—running out of fuel mid-battle or hitting an anti-vehicle mine is just the beginning.

• [b]Randomized Artillery Strikes[/b]
Survive the unexpected! Completely random artillery strikes will keep you on your toes—nowhere is safe.

• [b]Completely Revamped UI[/b]
I’ve streamlined the interface for a cleaner, more intuitive experience, so you can focus on what matters most: surviving.

And that’s just the beginning!

I’ve poured my heart into this update, and I can’t wait to hear your thoughts. What excites you most? What are you looking forward to exploring? Let me know!

I'm also excited to announce that a brand-new gameplay video is coming soon—stay tuned!—more surprises are just around the corner!
